name: load-e2e-roundtrip-scope-and-harness
body: The round-trip test drives the plan's edge model through a real scan into `db.lbug`: the transient plan row carries fqn/title/status only, its `AssignedTo`/`Implements` and per-kind operation rows join the Agent, Component and live/planned code targets, and every relation is re-queried with both endpoints exact while the retired record columns are asserted not to bind. The scan is the hermetic `testutil::scan_checkout` stand-in — real ingest straight to the derived database, no frontend process and no export. Limit: this test owns the plan edge model, not the spec-relation surface (Note/Details, Feedback/Reviews and Satisfies stay in the sibling e2e crates). Upgrade by folding those fixtures in if one test should own the whole surface, and switch to a frontend-driven scan if process-level coverage is required.
